snippet.title: Tape 101 Official Trailer | New Game+ Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A psychological horror descending through liminal spaces shaped by the Kübler-Ross model - the five stages of grief: denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance - where your perception and an RC car are the only tools to grasp what’s real

Wishlist Tape 101 HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010380/Tape_101/ 

________

Check out our socials:

(https://www.instagram.com/newgameshowcase)

(https://x.com/NewGameShowcase)

The New Game + Showcase is a creator-led games showcase designed to put authentic excitement back at the center of game reveals. Unlike traditional showcases, we don’t accept paid placements—every game we feature is there because our team of six core creators is genuinely excited about it. Our goal is to give developers and publishers a stage where their game isn’t competing for attention with dozens of sponsored slots, but instead stands out in front of communities that want to discover it.

Started by Luke Stephens, Luality, Jake Lucky, IamRob, Blue Thunder, and HUN2R, and produced by Gaming World Media, the New Game+ Showcase aims to provide value for an audience eager for genuine recommendations, which streamlines discovery for indie, AA, and AAA projects. 

#newgame #newgames #newgameplus
